notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Rogue that cannot be blocked by an opponent and that does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and creating a number of 1/1 Faerie Rogue creature tokens.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {3}{U}, returning Runic Repetition to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{R}, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand and exiling Mystic Retrieval.
Cast Runic Repetition by paying {2}{U}, returning Mystic Retrieval from exile to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
